vectors.criterion: Exact 230 is accepted without a floating-point token or noncanonical trailing zero.
A qualified link has native-owner evidence and does not expose a bus address as asset identity.
An inferred promoted fact names an acyclic versioned derivation and keeps native evidence.
Receipt and evaluation are ordered by one monotonic clock epoch.
A restart uses conservative comparable UTC intervals and retains the fact as stale.
An unknown native symbol remains representable without becoming a known semantic symbol.
Conflicting qualified candidates coexist and the kernel derives visible conflict metadata without publisher selection or resolution input.
A qualified available capability is bound to completed activation and one generation.
A partial update changes its named fact and retains an unrelated last-known good fact.
An identical sequence and digest replay is idempotent.
Fencing happens before the new snapshot exposes atomic capability withdrawal.
Exact current state and one qualified route admit a guarded operation.
A protocol acknowledgement without confirming readback remains explicitly unverified.
A newly revised post-dispatch observation, explicitly evaluated as fresh and confirmed by the exact effect rule, supports applied.
A new authorized intent with a new correlation remains admissible despite equal projected value.
Each requested (kind,item_id) tuple is accounted independently, including equal IDs under capability and operation.
A versioned legacy ID remains readable while operation routing stays bound to native capability instances.
A source restart establishes a new epoch and atomically retires old bindings and capabilities without conflating clock or driver generations.
Pure evaluation applies exact fresh/stale/expired boundaries without a native publication or snapshot mutation.
Fencing either source path of a two-source derivation atomically invalidates the derived candidate without inventing a binding.
A higher-generation transition explicitly fences and atomically supersedes every old actionable record, derived dependent, and guarded callback.
Multiple packs dispatch deterministically through the explicit pack and unique definition index in either registration order.
A to B to C preserves sender egress state and appends each receiving target exactly once after successful ingress.

The kernel creates conflict metadata, returns a snapshot-bound presentation selection, and atomically removes obsolete current metadata when one candidate is withdrawn while immutable history remains.
Complete immutable snapshot and evaluation inputs select the voltage candidate from the voltage envelope in a multi-key snapshot, deterministically and without hidden data.
A v2 record cannot be decoded as the v1 kernel.
Whitespace and an untyped bus-address surrogate cannot form an asset ID.
A non-zero coefficient with a trailing zero is not canonical.
A tagged value cannot select quantity and boolean payloads together.
Retention must be strictly longer than freshness.
Numeric monotonic ticks from different epochs cannot be subtracted.
Malformed digest and unredacted restricted evidence cannot enter a public record.
A two-node derivation cycle is rejected atomically.
Similar observations without native-owner evidence cannot qualify identity.
A stale expected revision cannot overwrite the current immutable snapshot.
The same source sequence with different canonical bytes is not idempotent.
A restarted source cannot continue publishing under its old epoch.
A route and guarded callback from a fenced generation fail before native dispatch.
Catalog or candidate presence does not create an actionable capability.
Degraded operation is unavailable without an explicit permitting contract.
Two eligible current routes fail closed before dispatch.
Admission requires the latest plausible now to be strictly before the earliest deadline.
An exact otherwise eligible candidate in an open conflict cannot satisfy an operation precondition.
An opaque authority reference must resolve for the exact intent and route.
Presentation selection cannot choose a native operation route.
The hard 16-hop and 300-second causal bounds cannot be enlarged by a target.
A reflected projection cannot re-enter the same target or create fresh authority.
An indeterminate operation cannot blindly retry or fall back after possible dispatch.
Equal item IDs under different kinds still require two exact tuple dispositions.
A legacy public identity cannot become a native endpoint or route.
Unknown delivery with possible side effect cannot be classified as proven no contact.
Duplicate JSON members are rejected before typed decoding.
An undeclared v1 member is not silently discarded into an extension bag.
Trailing data after one JSON value is rejected before typed decoding.
A missing required exponent member has one stable rejection class.
An enum token outside the exact v1 set is rejected deterministically.
A collection beyond its explicit maximum is rejected without truncation.
Set-like derivation inputs in descending candidate order are rejected rather than silently reordered.
A first-sequence syntactically valid digest must match the canonical batch bytes.
A derived input that does not resolve to its exact candidate revision is rejected.
A confirming candidate from a replacement driver generation cannot prove the earlier admitted route applied.
A capability disposition cannot also account for the equal operation item ID.
Admission re-evaluates time and rejects a now-stale precondition even though the immutable snapshot stored fresh.
A fresh available value cannot satisfy a write precondition when the exactly named candidate is unqualified and unpromoted.
Equal numeric revisions and a true same-key candidate cannot replace the exact qualified candidate whose value makes the predicate false.
An unrelated later observation on the same admitted route cannot self-assert confirms for the operation-specific effect.
A higher-generation publication without an explicit fence cannot retain or silently supersede the older actionable generation.
Two packs cannot claim the same operation definition kind, ID, and version.
An explicit pack with no exact operation index entry fails without prefix inference or probing another validator.
A matching pre-dispatch candidate retained unchanged in a later snapshot cannot prove applied.
A complete cross-epoch evaluation whose wall uncertainty exceeds policy cannot establish fresh readback for applied.
An empty qualified identity basis uses the identity-specific error, not invalid_evidence.
Empty activation proof uses the capability-specific error, not invalid_evidence.
A decoded precondition whose exact candidate is absent uses precondition_failed, not dangling_reference.
A precondition candidate revision mismatch uses precondition_failed, not revision_conflict or dangling_reference.
C to A reflection is rejected before append because A already appears in the entered-target path.
A malformed causal time token keeps the parser-specific invalid_time error even when causal domain limits also fail.
A valid receiver ingress that has no remaining hop capacity uses the causal-domain error before append and leaves the context unchanged.
A decoded snapshot cannot omit candidate evidence from kernel-derived conflict metadata.
A native publication cannot submit cross-source conflict metadata through an undeclared batch member.
A deterministic policy result from another fact envelope cannot be labeled as the requested voltage selection.
Selection rejects otherwise valid snapshot and evaluation inputs whose snapshot IDs differ.
Selection rejects a view whose complete revision vector differs from its snapshot.
A syntactically valid evaluation digest that does not match the canonical view bytes is rejected before policy dispatch.
A requested fact key absent from the supplied immutable snapshot is rejected before policy dispatch.
A view that omits a snapshot candidate cannot provide the complete selector input.
A selection result must repeat the complete evaluation context exactly rather than substitute another monotonic point.
Selection dispatch requires one exact registered kernel policy ID and version.
Duplicate registration of the same kernel selection-policy ID and version is rejected deterministically.
A correctly redigested view whose candidate revision differs from the immutable snapshot is rejected before policy dispatch.
